# ZViewer

> ZViewer is an offline native Android comic reader for local archives (ZIP/CBZ, RAR/CBR, 7Z), PDF, and image folders, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

ZViewer (`dev.zolive.zviewer`) targets Android 10+ (minSdk 29, compile/target SDK 36) and ships a universal APK for `arm64-v8a` and `x86_64`. All content is processed on-device: the release manifest requests no network, external-storage, or all-files permissions, and uses a Storage Access Framework (SAF) persistent read grant for a user-selected library folder. The UI and Chinese docs are written in Simplified Chinese. Current version: 1.0.1 (`versionCode 2`). License: Apache-2.0.

## Features

- Comic sources: ZIP / CBZ, RAR / CBR, 7Z (via libarchive), PDF (via `PdfRenderer`), and image folders.
- Static images: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, HEIF, HEIC, AVIF.
- Animated images: APNG, animated WebP, GIF, animated AVIF (via APNG4Android + libavif).
- Library: recursive scan, natural filename sorting (`2.jpg` before `10.jpg`), HD covers, search, reading-status filter, recently read, favorites, 2–5 column grid.
- Reader: vertical continuous or horizontal paging, left-to-right or right-to-left direction, pinch/double-tap zoom (fit-to-screen up to 5x), draggable floating progress bar, page-number jump, per-page progress persistence, keep screen on.
- Appearance: follow-system / light / dark theme, preset or custom accent color, independent light/dark reading backgrounds.
- Storage: manual cache clearing plus automatic reclamation at ~1.5 GiB.

## Supported Formats

| Kind | Extensions |
| --- | --- |
| Archives | `zip`, `cbz`, `rar`, `cbr`, `7z` |
| Documents | `pdf` |
| Static images | `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `webp`, `bmp`, `heif`, `heic`, `avif` |
| Animated images | `apng`, animated `webp`, `gif`, animated `avif` |

Not supported: encrypted or multi-volume archives, password-protected PDFs, DRM content, animated HEIF. Solid 7Z archives require preparing the whole book on first open.

## Architecture

- `app/src/main/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/MainActivity.kt` — single Activity, edge-to-edge Compose host.
- `LibraryViewModel.kt` — app state, SAF folder selection, scan/open jobs, error mapping, settings and progress.
- `data/PreferenceStore.kt` — SharedPreferences persistence for tree URI, book index JSON, page progress, favorites, settings.
- `data/BookRepository.kt` — `DocumentsContract` bulk queries, background extraction, PDF rendering, cover and page caches; enforces safety limits.
- `data/Models.kt` — `Book`, `BookSession`, `PageSource`, `ReadingProgress`, `ReaderSettings`, `NaturalOrder`, `ReaderException`.
- `reader/ImageLoader.kt` — PNG-chunk APNG detection, AVIF via APNG4Android + libavif, other formats via `ImageDecoder`, sampled animation wrapper.
- `reader/ZoomImageView.kt` — native matrix zoom/pan in an `AndroidView`; unzoomed gestures pass through to Compose lists/pager.
- `ui/LibraryScreen.kt` — `ZViewerApp` entry, library grid, search/filter, continue-reading card.
- `ui/ReaderScreen.kt` — LazyColumn / HorizontalPager reader with floating progress panel.
- `ui/SettingsScreen.kt`, `ui/Theme.kt` — Material 3 settings and theming.

Data flow: user picks a folder → SAF persistent read permission → background recursive scan → book index → cover generated on demand → book opened → pages prepared → visible/adjacent pages decoded → page number saved.

## Privacy and Security

- No `INTERNET`, external-storage read/write, or `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permission; no accounts, ads, or telemetry.
- Only the user-granted directory is read; original comic files are never modified, moved, or deleted.
- Backups and device-to-device migration are disabled so URI grants do not migrate with app data.
- Archive members are written to app-generated sequential filenames; hidden files, macOS metadata (`.`, `__MACOSX`), symlinks, and non-image entries are skipped.
- Safety limits: 20,000 pages per comic, 256 MB per image, 4 GB extracted per book, archive scan recursion depth 32.

## Build and Test

Requirements: JDK 17, Android SDK 36, network access for dependency download, Gradle 8.11.1 wrapper (bundled).

```sh
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android"
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug
./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest              # device format integration tests
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease                          # signed release build
```

- Unit tests: `app/src/test/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/data/NaturalOrderTest.kt` (natural ordering, hidden-file filtering, cache keys, image extensions).
- Instrumented tests: `app/src/androidTest/java/dev/zolive/zviewer/FormatIntegrationTest.kt` covering CBZ/ZIP, RAR4/CBR, RAR5, 7Z, PDF, image folders, HEIF/HEIC/AVIF, animated formats, corrupt/empty archives, path traversal, and a 4800×3200 APNG.
- Fixtures: generated by `tools/generate_fixtures.py`; `tools/ui_smoke.py` replays most manual UI flows.
- Release signing: key `.signing/zviewer-release.jks` (alias `zviewer`), passwords from `ZVIEWER_STORE_PASSWORD` / `ZVIEWER_KEY_PASSWORD`; output `app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`. Never commit `.signing/`.
- Distributed APKs live in `dist/` with SHA-256 checksums (e.g. `ZViewer-1.0.1-release.apk`).

## Key Dependencies

`androidx.compose:compose-bom:2025.05.01`, `androidx.activity:activity-compose:1.10.1`, `androidx.lifecycle:*:2.9.0`, Kotlin coroutines 1.10.2, `me.zhanghai.android.libarchive:library:1.1.6`, `com.github.penfeizhou.android.animation:apng:3.0.5` and `:avif:3.0.5`, `org.aomedia.avif.android:avif:1.3.0.841110fd`.
